name: ami-pharma-mobile
description: AMI PHARMA — application de gestion de pharmacie web et Android

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run web:build && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:copy: npm run web:build && npx cap copy android
scripts.android:debug: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
